conversation.text: You said what is expected this week is unclear. What is happening?

Aiyoyo, as a new hire already week 3 here also blur lah because everything feels so rojak since morning! First thing first, that Butterworth bus as usual damn late, making me rush like mad to punch in, then walking straight into office kena blast by this super freezing aircon like Genting Highlands, steady lah! Then want to log into SAP also headache because the access came late last week, and now when I try to check anything, my team lead confirm on endless calls all day long, cannot catch her at all. The quota is so high this week, really testing my patience, but luckily just now the canteen nasi lemak is nice and sedap gila, so at least stomach full can tahan a bit. But actually the main real issue lah, nobody gave me the vendor master rules, so invoices get rejected and then I have to redo them all over again!
What would help you with the vendor master rules and redoing invoices?

Aiyoyo, honestly speaking lah, to fix this headache with the vendor master rules and all these stupid invoice rejections, I really need someone to just sit down with me for like ten minutes and pass me the proper cheat sheet or SOP document, because right now I am totally guessing like blind man crossing the road! If my team lead can spare even a small gap between her non-stop meetings to point me to where the shared drive folder is, or maybe assign a senior buddy to guide me through just two or three live examples, confirm can settle fast-fast one. Otherwise, everyday keep redoing the same batch of invoices until my eyes also blur and my supervisor ask why productivity drop, very jialat you know! Also lah, maybe if the office aircon not so much like freezer room, my brain can function better to absorb all these complicated SAP vendor categories without freezing halfway. Seriously, just need that standard guideline doc or a quick walkthrough session, then I promise my accuracy will shoot up sky high already, steady!
